patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Sellfy and Shopware share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Sellfy and Shopware share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Sellfy only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerc” rather than Shopware's shape. Choose Shopware only if your buying job matches “Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$6” rather than Sellfy's shape. Workflow advantage: Sellfy leans digital-business-marketplace; Shopware leans catalog-management, wholesale-b2b. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Sellfy and Shopware share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Sellfy is Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerce.; Shopware is Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$660/mo; Evolve from €2400/mo; Beyond quote..
- Company-size focus: Sellfy (micro, small-business) vs Shopware (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Sellfy-leaning digital-business-marketplace vs Shopware-leaning catalog-management, wholesale-b2b.
- Researched limits: Sellfy — none listed; Shopware — Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV.

Limitations — Sellfy: —; Shopware: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV; Rise commercial floor is high versus WooCommerce core + hosting.
